name: Acid Arrow
desc: A shimmering green arrow streaks toward a target within range and bursts in a spray of acid. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 4d4 acid damage immediately and 2d4 acid damage at the end of its next turn. On a miss, the arrow splashes the target with acid for half as much of the initial damage and no damage at the end of its next turn.
damage: 4d4 acid + 2d4 acid at the end of it's next turn

name: Acid Splash
desc: You hurl a bubble of acid. Choose one creature within range, or choose two creatures within range that are within 5 feet of each other. A target must succeed on a dexterity saving throw or take 1d6 acid damage.

name: Aid
desc: Your spell bolsters your allies with toughness and resolve. Choose up to three creatures within range. Each target's hit point maximum and current hit points increase by 5 for the duration.

name: Alarm
desc: You set an alarm against unwanted intrusion. Choose a door, a window, or an area within range that is no larger than a 20-foot cube. Until the spell ends, an alarm alerts you whenever a Tiny or larger creature touches or enters the warded area. When you cast the spell, you can designate creatures that won't set off the alarm. You also choose whether the alarm is mental or audible.

name: Alter Self
desc: You assume a different form. When you cast the spell, choose one of the following options, the effects of which last for the duration of the spell. While the spell lasts, you can end one option as an action to gain the benefits of a different one.

name: Animal Friendship
desc: This spell lets you convince a beast that you mean it no harm. Choose a beast that you can see within range. It must see and hear you. If the beast's Intelligence is 4 or higher, the spell fails. Otherwise, the beast must succeed on a wisdom saving throw or be charmed by you for the spell's duration. If you or one of your companions harms the target, the spells ends.

name: Animal Messenger
desc: By means of this spell, you use an animal to deliver a message. Choose a Tiny beast you can see within range, such as a squirrel, a blue jay, or a bat. You specify a location, which you must have visited, and a recipient who matches a general description, such as "a man or woman dressed in the uniform of the town guard" or "a red-haired dwarf wearing a pointed hat." You also speak a message of up to twenty-five words. The target beast travels for the duration of the spell toward the specified location, covering about 50 miles per 24 hours for a flying messenger, or 25 miles for other animals.

name: Animal Shapes
desc: Your magic turns others into beasts. Choose any number of willing creatures that you can see within range. You transform each target into the form of a Large or smaller beast with a challenge rating of 4 or lower. On subsequent turns, you can use your action to transform affected creatures into new forms.

name: Animate Dead
desc: This spell creates an undead servant. Choose a pile of bones or a corpse of a Medium or Small humanoid within range. Your spell imbues the target with a foul mimicry of life, raising it as an undead creature. The target becomes a skeleton if you chose bones or a zombie if you chose a corpse (the GM has the creature's game statistics).

name: Animate Objects
desc: Objects come to life at your command. Choose up to ten nonmagical objects within range that are not being worn or carried. Medium targets count as two objects, Large targets count as four objects, Huge targets count as eight objects. You can't animate any object larger than Huge. Each target animates and becomes a creature under your control until the spell ends or until reduced to 0 hit points.

name: Anti-life Shell
desc: A shimmering barrier extends out from you in a 10-foot radius and moves with you, remaining centered on you and hedging out creatures other than undead and constructs. The barrier lasts for the duration.

name: Antimagic Field
desc: A 10-foot-radius invisible sphere of antimagic surrounds you. This area is divorced from the magical energy that suffuses the multiverse. Within the sphere, spells can't be cast, summoned creatures disappear, and even magic items become mundane. Until the spell ends, the sphere moves with you, centered on you.

name: Antipathy/Sympathy
desc: This spell attracts or repels creatures of your choice. You target something within range, either a Huge or smaller object or creature or an area that is no larger than a 200-foot cube. Then specify a kind of intelligent creature, such as red dragons, goblins, or vampires. You invest the target with an aura that either attracts or repels the specified creatures for the duration. Choose antipathy or sympathy as the aura's effect.

name: Arcane Eye
desc: You create an invisible, magical eye within range that hovers in the air for the duration.

name: Arcane Hand
desc: You create a Large hand of shimmering, translucent force in an unoccupied space that you can see within range. The hand lasts for the spell's duration, and it moves at your command, mimicking the movements of your own hand.

name: Arcane Lock
desc: You touch a closed door, window, gate, chest, or other entryway, and it becomes locked for the duration. You and the creatures you designate when you cast this spell can open the object normally. You can also set a password that, when spoken within 5 feet of the object, suppresses this spell for 1 minute. Otherwise, it is impassable until it is broken or the spell is dispelled or suppressed. Casting knock on the object suppresses arcane lock for 10 minutes.

name: Arcane Sword
desc: You create a sword-shaped plane of force that hovers within range. It lasts for the duration.

name: Arcanist's Magic Aura
desc: You place an illusion on a creature or an object you touch so that divination spells reveal false information about it. The target can be a willing creature or an object that isn't being carried or worn by another creature.

name: Astral Projection
desc: You and up to eight willing creatures within range project your astral bodies into the Astral Plane (the spell fails and the casting is wasted if you are already on that plane). The material body you leave behind is unconscious and in a state of suspended animation; it doesn't need food or air and doesn't age.

name: Augury
desc: By casting gem-inlaid sticks, rolling dragon bones, laying out ornate cards, or employing some other divining tool, you receive an omen from an otherworldly entity about the results of a specific course of action that you plan to take within the next 30 minutes. The GM chooses from the following possible omens:

name: Awaken
desc: After spending the casting time tracing magical pathways within a precious gemstone, you touch a Huge or smaller beast or plant. The target must have either no Intelligence score or an Intelligence of 3 or less. The target gains an Intelligence of 10. The target also gains the ability to speak one language you know. If the target is a plant, it gains the ability to move its limbs, roots, vines, creepers, and so forth, and it gains senses similar to a human's. Your GM chooses statistics appropriate for the awakened plant, such as the statistics for the awakened shrub or the awakened tree.

name: Bane
desc: Up to three creatures of your choice that you can see within range must make charisma saving throws. Whenever a target that fails this saving throw makes an attack roll or a saving throw before the spell ends, the target must roll a d4 and subtract the number rolled from the attack roll or saving throw.

name: Banishment
desc: You attempt to send one creature that you can see within range to another plane of existence. The target must succeed on a charisma saving throw or be banished.

name: Barkskin
desc: You touch a willing creature. Until the spell ends, the target's skin has a rough, bark-like appearance, and the target's AC can't be less than 16, regardless of what kind of armor it is wearing.

name: Beacon of Hope
desc: This spell bestows hope and vitality. Choose any number of creatures within range. For the duration, each target has advantage on wisdom saving throws and death saving throws, and regains the maximum number of hit points possible from any healing.

name: Bestow Curse
desc: You touch a creature, and that creature must succeed on a wisdom saving throw or become cursed for the duration of the spell. When you cast this spell, choose the nature of the curse from the following options:

name: Black Tentacles
desc: Squirming, ebony tentacles fill a 20-foot square on ground that you can see within range. For the duration, these tentacles turn the ground in the area into difficult terrain.

name: Blade Barrier
desc: You create a vertical wall of whirling, razor-sharp blades made of magical energy. The wall appears within range and lasts for the duration. You can make a straight wall up to 100 feet long, 20 feet high, and 5 feet thick, or a ringed wall up to 60 feet in diameter, 20 feet high, and 5 feet thick. The wall provides three-quarters cover to creatures behind it, and its space is difficult terrain.

name: Bless
desc: You bless up to three creatures of your choice within range. Whenever a target makes an attack roll or a saving throw before the spell ends, the target can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to the attack roll or saving throw.

name: Blight
desc: Necromantic energy washes over a creature of your choice that you can see within range, draining moisture and vitality from it. The target must make a constitution saving throw. The target takes 8d8 necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The spell has no effect on undead or constructs.

name: Blindness/Deafness
desc: You can blind or deafen a foe. Choose one creature that you can see within range to make a constitution saving throw. If it fails, the target is either blinded or deafened (your choice) for the duration. At the end of each of its turns, the target can make a constitution saving throw. On a success, the spell ends.

name: Blink
desc: Roll a d20 at the end of each of your turns for the duration of the spell. On a roll of 11 or higher, you vanish from your current plane of existence and appear in the Ethereal Plane (the spell fails and the casting is wasted if you were already on that plane). At the start of your next turn, and when the spell ends if you are on the Ethereal Plane, you return to an unoccupied space of your choice that you can see within 10 feet of the space you vanished from. If no unoccupied space is available within that range, you appear in the nearest unoccupied space (chosen at random if more than one space is equally near). You can dismiss this spell as an action.

name: Blur
desc: Your body becomes blurred, shifting and wavering to all who can see you. For the duration, any creature has disadvantage on attack rolls against you. An attacker is immune to this effect if it doesn't rely on sight, as with blindsight, or can see through illusions, as with truesight.

name: Branding Smite
desc: The next time you hit a creature with a weapon attack before this spell ends, the weapon gleams with astral radiance as you strike. The attack deals an extra 2d6 radiant damage to the target, which becomes visible if it's invisible, and the target sheds dim light in a 5-foot radius and can't become invisible until the spell ends.

name: Burning Hands
desc: As you hold your hands with thumbs touching and fingers spread, a thin sheet of flames shoots forth from your outstretched fingertips. Each creature in a 15-foot cone must make a dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 3d6 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

name: Call Lightning
desc: A storm cloud (10 ft. tall, 60 ft. radius) forms above you, failing indoors. When cast and on subsequent turns using an action, you strike a point beneath it with lightning forcing targets within 5 feet to make a Dexterity save or take 3d10 lightning damage (half on a success). Outdoors in an existing storm, you control the natural weather instead and increase the damage to 4d10.
damage: 3d10 lightning damage + more if natural weather

name: Calm Emotions
desc: You attempt to suppress strong emotions in a group of people. Each humanoid in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you choose within range must make a charisma saving throw; a creature can choose to fail this saving throw if it wishes. If a creature fails its saving throw, choose one of the following two effects. You can suppress any effect causing a target to be charmed or frightened. When this spell ends, any suppressed effect resumes, provided that its duration has not expired in the meantime.

name: Chain Lightning
desc: You create a bolt of lightning that arcs toward a target of your choice that you can see within range. Three bolts then leap from that target to as many as three other targets, each of which must be within 30 feet of the first target. A target can be a creature or an object and can be targeted by only one of the bolts.

name: Charm Person
desc: You attempt to charm a humanoid you can see within range. It must make a wisdom saving throw, and does so with advantage if you or your companions are fighting it. If it fails the saving throw, it is charmed by you until the spell ends or until you or your companions do anything harmful to it. The charmed creature regards you as a friendly acquaintance. When the spell ends, the creature knows it was charmed by you.

name: Chill Touch
desc: You create a ghostly, skeletal hand in the space of a creature within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the creature to assail it with the chill of the grave. On a hit, the target takes 1d8 necrotic damage, and it can't regain hit points until the start of your next turn. Until then, the hand clings to the target.
damage: 1d8 necro - can't regain until your next turn.

name: Circle of Death
desc: A sphere of negative energy ripples out in a 60-foot radius sphere from a point within range. Each creature in that area must make a constitution saving throw. A target takes 8d6 necrotic damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

name: Clairvoyance
desc: You create an invisible sensor within range in a location familiar to you (a place you have visited or seen before) or in an obvious location that is unfamiliar to you (such as behind a door, around a corner, or in a grove of trees). The sensor remains in place for the duration, and it can't be attacked or otherwise interacted with.

name: Clone
desc: An inert duplicate of a creature grows in a sealed vessel over 120 days. If the original dies after maturity, its soul transfers to the clone with all memories, personality, and abilities intact. Physical equipment is left behind, and the original remains can no longer be resurrected.

name: Cloudkill
desc: Creates a 20-foot-radius sphere of yellow-green fog that heavily obscures the area and spreads around corners. A creature entering the area or starting its turn there must make a Constitution save, taking 5d8 poison damage on a failure or half on a success (breathing is not required). The fog moves 10 feet away from you at the start of each of your turns, sinking into low ground and dispersing in strong wind.

name: Color Spray
desc: A 15-foot cone of flashing lights springs from your hand, affecting up to 6d10 total hit points of creatures. Creatures in the area are affected in ascending order of their current hit points (ignoring unconscious or unseeing targets), becoming blinded until the end of your next turn. Subtract each target's hit points from the total before moving to the next.

name: Command
desc: You speak a one-word command to a creature you can see within range. The target must succeed on a wisdom saving throw or follow the command on its next turn. The spell has no effect if the target is undead, if it doesn't understand your language, or if your command is directly harmful to it.

name: Commune
desc: You contact your deity or divine proxy to ask up to three yes-or-no questions before the spell ends, receiving correct answers, 'unclear' for topics beyond their knowledge, or a short phrase from the DM to avoid misleading responses. Casting this spell two or more times before a long rest incurs a cumulative 25 percent secret chance per additional casting of receiving no answer.

name: Commune With Nature
desc: You briefly become one with nature and gain knowledge of the surrounding territory. In the outdoors, the spell gives you knowledge of the land within 3 miles of you. In caves and other natural underground settings, the radius is limited to 300 feet. The spell doesn't function where nature has been replaced by construction, such as in dungeons and towns.

name: Comprehend Languages
desc: For the spell's duration, you understand the literal meaning of any spoken language you hear and any written language you touch while reading (at a rate of about 1 minute per page). The spell only translates standard written and spoken languages, meaning it cannot decode secret messages, arcane sigils, or non-language glyphs.

name: Compulsion
desc: Visible creatures of your choice within range that can hear you must make a Wisdom saving throw (automatically succeeding if immune to being charmed), falling under the spell's effect on a failure. For the duration, you can use a bonus action on each of your turns to choose a horizontal direction, forcing each target to use all its movement on its next turn to head that way (provoking opportunity attacks, but avoiding obviously deadly hazards). Affected targets can take their action before moving and repeat the Wisdom saving throw after the movement to try to end the effect.

name: Cone of Cold
desc: You release a 60-foot cone of cold air that forces each creature inside to make a Constitution saving throw, taking 8d8 cold damage on a failure or half as much on a success, with any slain creature freezing into a statue until it thaws. When cast using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d8 for each slot level above 5th.

name: Confusion
desc: Each creature in a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on a point within range must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw when cast or be affected for the duration, losing its reactions and rolling a d10 at the start of each of its turns to determine its forced behavior (1: random movement and no action; 2–6: no movement or action; 7–8: melee attack against a random reachable creature; 9–10: act and move normally). Affected targets can repeat the Wisdom saving throw at the end of each turn to end the effect early, and using a spell slot of 5th level or higher increases the sphere's radius by 5 feet for each slot level above 4th.

name: Conjure Animals
desc: You summon friendly fey spirits in unoccupied visible spaces within range that take the form of beasts—choosing one CR 2, two CR 1, four CR 1/2, or eight CR 1/4 creatures—which vanish at 0 hit points or when the spell ends. The summoned beasts roll initiative as a group, act on their own turns, obey your free verbal commands (or default to self-defense), and multiplying the number of summoned creatures when upcast using a 5th-level (x2), 7th-level (x3), or 9th-level (x4) slot.

name: Conjure Celestial
desc: You summon a friendly celestial of CR 4 or lower in an unoccupied visible space within range, which vanishes when reduced to 0 hit points or when the spell ends. The celestial rolls its own initiative, acts on its own turns, and obeys your free verbal commands as long as they don't violate its alignment (defaulting to self-defense if no commands are given).

name: Conjure Elemental
desc: You summon a friendly celestial of CR 4 or lower (or CR 5 or lower when cast using a 9th-level slot) in an unoccupied visible space within range, which vanishes at 0 hit points or when the spell ends. The celestial rolls its own initiative, acts on its own turns, and obeys your free verbal commands as long as they align with its alignment, defaulting to self-defense if given no instructions.

name: Conjure Fey
desc: You summon a friendly fey creature or beast-shaped fey spirit of CR 6 or lower (increasing by +1 CR per slot level above 6th) in an unoccupied visible space within range, which rolls its own initiative and obeys your free verbal commands provided they don't violate its alignment (defaulting to self-defense otherwise). The creature disappears at 0 hit points or when the spell ends, but breaking your concentration causes you to lose control, turning it hostile toward you and your companions until it disappears 1 hour after being summoned.

name: Conjure Minor Elementals
desc: You summon friendly elementals in unoccupied visible spaces within range—choosing one CR 2, two CR 1, four CR 1/2, or eight CR 1/4 creatures—which vanish at 0 hit points or when the spell ends. The elementals roll initiative as a group, act on their own turns, obey your free verbal commands (or default to self-defense), and double or triple in number when upcast using a 6th-level or 8th-level slot, respectively.

name: Conjure Woodland Beings
desc: You summon friendly fey creatures in unoccupied visible spaces within range—choosing one CR 2, two CR 1, four CR 1/2, or eight CR 1/4 creatures—which vanish at 0 hit points or when the spell ends. The fey roll initiative as a group, act on their own turns, obey your free verbal commands (or default to self-defense), and double or triple in number when upcast using a 6th-level or 8th-level slot, respectively.

name: Contact Other Plane
desc: You mentally contact an extraplanar entity, requiring a DC 15 Intelligence saving throw; on a failure, you take 6d6 psychic damage and become insane until a long rest or greater restoration (incapable of taking actions, reading, understanding speech, or speaking coherently). On a success, you may ask the entity up to five questions before the spell ends, receiving single-word answers (or a short phrase if a one-word answer would be misleading) from the DM.

name: Contagion
desc: On a successful melee spell attack, the target becomes poisoned and must make a Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns until it achieves either three successes (ending the spell) or three failures (inflicting a chosen natural disease for the duration). The available diseases impose specific afflictions: Blinding Sickness (blinded; disadvantage on Wis checks/saves), Filth Fever (disadvantage on Str checks/saves/attacks), Flesh Rot (vulnerability to all damage; disadvantage on Cha checks), Mindfire (acts as if under confusion in combat; disadvantage on Int checks/saves), Seizure (disadvantage on Dex checks/saves/attacks), and Slimy Doom (stunned until end of next turn whenever taking damage; disadvantage on Con checks/saves).

name: Contingency
desc: You cast a 1st–5th level spell with a 1-action casting time that can target you (expending slots for both), holding it in reserve until a trigger condition specified during casting occurs. When the trigger is met for the first time, the contingent spell immediately takes effect strictly on you and contingency ends. You can only maintain one active contingency at a time (re-casting ends the previous one), and the spell ends early if its material component is no longer on your person.

name: Continual Flame
desc: A flame, equivalent in brightness to a torch, springs forth from an object that you touch. The effect looks like a regular flame, but it creates no heat and doesn't use oxygen. A continual flame can be covered or hidden but not smothered or quenched.

name: Control Water
desc: For the duration, you control freestanding water within a cube up to 100 feet on a side, selecting or changing one of four effects upon casting or as an action on your turn: Flood raises water levels by up to 20 feet or creates a recurring 20-foot wave that moves Huge or smaller vehicles (with a 25% capsize chance); Part Water separates water to form a trench with side walls that fills back in over one round when ended; Redirect Flow forces flowing water to travel in a chosen direction (even up walls) until it exits the area; and Whirlpool (requires water at least 50 ft square and 25 ft deep) creates a 25-foot-tall vortex that pulls nearby targets 10 feet inward, deals 2d8 bludgeoning damage to objects entering it, and forces creatures entering or starting their turn inside to make a Strength saving throw—taking 2d8 bludgeoning damage (half on success) and becoming trapped inside on a failure, requiring a Strength (Athletics) check at disadvantage as an action to escape.

name: Control Weather
desc: Castable only while outdoors with a clear path to the sky, this spell allows you to alter the weather within a 5-mile radius, gradually returning to normal once the spell ends. Every 1d4 × 10 minutes, you can shift the current Precipitation (Clear to Torrential/Blizzard), Temperature (Unbearable Heat to Arctic Cold), or Wind (Calm to Storm) by one stage up or down on their respective tables, as well as change the wind's direction; moving indoors or breaking line of sight to the sky ends the spell early.

name: Counterspell
desc: You interrupt a creature casting a spell, causing it to automatically fail with no effect if it is 3rd level or lower; for spells of 4th level or higher, you must succeed on an ability check using your spellcasting ability (DC = 10 + spell's level) to negate it. When upcast using a slot of 4th level or higher, any spell with a level equal to or lower than the slot used is automatically negated without a roll.

name: Create Food and Water
desc: You create 45 pounds of food and 30 gallons of water on the ground or in containers within range, enough to sustain up to fifteen humanoids or five steeds for 24 hours. The food is bland but nourishing, and spoils if uneaten after 24 hours. The water is clean and doesn't go bad.

name: Create or Destroy Water
desc: You choose to either create or destroy water within range: Create Water fills an open container with up to 10 gallons of clean water or creates rain in a 30-foot cube that douses exposed flames, while Destroy Water removes up to 10 gallons of water from an open container or disperses fog in a 30-foot cube. Upcasting using a 2nd-level slot or higher increases the water volume by 10 gallons or expands the cube's dimensions by 5 feet for each slot level above 1st.

name: Create Undead
desc: Castable only at night, this spell turns up to three Small or Medium humanoid corpses within range into ghouls under your control for 24 hours, after which you must recast the spell to reassert control over them before the timer expires. You can use a bonus action to mentally issue commands to any or all controlled undead within 120 feet (which they carry out until complete, defaulting to self-defense if uncommanded), and upcasting expands your options: 4 ghouls at 7th level; 5 ghouls or 2 ghasts/wights at 8th level; and 6 ghouls, 3 ghasts/wights, or 2 mummies at 9th level.

name: Creation
desc: You weave shadow material from the Shadowfell to create a nonliving object (up to a 5-foot cube) out of vegetable or mineral matter you have seen before, lasting for a duration determined by its material—vegetable matter (1 day), stone/crystal (12 hours), precious metals (1 hour), gems (10 minutes), or adamantine/mithral (1 minute), using the shortest duration for composite items. Created materials automatically fail if used as material components for other spells, and upcasting using a 6th-level slot or higher increases the cube's dimensions by 5 feet for each slot level above 5th.

name: Cure Wounds
desc: A creature you touch regains a number of hit points equal to 1d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs.

name: Dancing Lights
desc: You create up to four torch-sized hovering lights (appearing as torches, lanterns, or glowing orbs) or combine them into a single Medium glowing humanoid shape, each shedding dim light in a 10-foot radius for the duration. As a bonus action, you can move the lights up to 60 feet to a new spot within range, provided each light remains within 20 feet of another light from the spell and stays within the spell's total range (otherwise winking out).

name: Darkness
desc: Magical darkness fills a 15-foot-radius sphere centered on a point within range—spreading around corners, blocking darkvision, and preventing nonmagical light from illuminating it—or emanates from a held or unequipped object (moving with it until completely covered by an opaque object). The darkness for the duration automatically dispels any spell of 2nd level or lower that creates light within an overlapping area.

name: Darkvision
desc: You touch a willing creature to grant it the ability to see in the dark. For the duration, that creature has darkvision out to a range of 60 feet.

name: Daylight
desc: A 60-foot-radius sphere of bright light centered on a point within range sheds additional dim light for another 60 feet, or emanates from a held or unequipped object (moving with it until completely covered by an opaque object). Any overlapping area of darkness created by a spell of 3rd level or lower is automatically dispelled.

name: Death Ward
desc: You touch a creature to grant it protection from death for 8 hours; the first time it would drop to 0 hit points from taking damage, it instead drops to 1 hit point and the spell ends, or if it is subjected to an effect that would kill it instantly without dealing damage, that effect is negated and the spell ends.

name: Delayed Blast Fireball
desc: You create a glowing bead at a point within range that detonates into a 20-foot-radius sphere of fire when your concentration ends or is broken, dealing 12d6 base fire damage (half on a successful Dexterity save) and igniting flammable objects not being worn or carried. The damage increases by 1d6 at the end of each turn it hasn't detonated, and touching the bead forces a Dexterity save to either immediately detonate it on a failure or allow the creature to throw it up to 40 feet to explode on impact, with upcasting of 8th level or higher increasing base damage by 1d6 per slot level above 7th.

name: Demiplane
desc: Creates a shadowy door on a flat surface leading to an empty 30-foot cubic room made of wood or stone. When the spell ends, the door disappears, trapping any creatures or objects left inside. Each casting allows you to create a new demiplane, reconnect to one you previously created, or connect to another creature's demiplane if you know its nature and contents.

name: Detect Evil and Good
desc: For the duration, you know if there is an aberration, celestial, elemental, fey, fiend, or undead within 30 feet of you, as well as its location. You also sense any place or object within 30 feet that has been magically consecrated or desecrated. The spell penetrates most barriers, but is blocked by 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of metal, a thin sheet of lead, or 3 feet of wood or dirt.

name: Detect Magic
desc: For the duration, you sense the presence of magic within 30 feet of you. You can use an action to see a faint aura around any visible magic-bearing creature or object in the area and learn its school of magic. The spell penetrates most barriers, but is blocked by 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of metal, a thin sheet of lead, or 3 feet of wood or dirt.

name: Detect Poison and Disease
desc: For the duration, you sense the presence and location of poisons, poisonous creatures, and diseases within 30 feet of you. You also identify the specific kind of poison, poisonous creature, or disease in each case. The spell penetrates most barriers, but is blocked by 1 foot of stone, 1 inch of metal, a thin sheet of lead, or 3 feet of wood or dirt.

name: Detect Thoughts
desc: Read surface thoughts of a creature within 30 feet (Int 3+ and speaks a language). You can use an action to probe deeper, forcing a Wisdom save to gain insight into its reasoning, emotions, and major concerns; on a save or probe, the target detects you, and it can break the spell with a contested Intelligence check. You can also search for unseen thinking minds within 30 feet through most barriers.

name: Dimension Door
desc: You teleport to a target spot within range that you can see, visualize, or specify by distance and direction, bringing along gear within your carrying capacity plus one willing creature of your size or smaller within 5 feet. If the destination is already occupied by an object or creature, the teleportation fails and both you and your traveling companion take 4d6 force damage.

name: Disguise Self
desc: You alter your appearance and gear for the duration (or until dismissed as an action), adjusting your height by up to 1 foot and varying your build, though your fundamental body shape and limb structure remain unchanged. The tactile illusion fails physical inspection—touching illusory additions passes through them or hits your actual body—and a creature can discern the disguise by using an action to succeed on an Intelligence (Investigation) check against your spell save DC

name: Disintegrate
desc: You fire a green ray at a visible target within range (creature, object, or magical force creation): creatures must make a Dexterity save or take 10d6 + 40 force damage, turning into gray dust alongside nonmagical gear if reduced to 0 hit points (restorable only via true resurrection or wish). Nonmagical objects or force creations of Large size or smaller are automatically disintegrated entirely, while Huge or larger targets lose a 10-foot-cube section (magic items are unaffected), and upcasting using a 7th-level slot or higher increases the damage by 3d6 per slot level above 6th.

name: Dispel Evil and Good
desc: For the duration, celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, and undead have disadvantage on attack rolls against you, and you can expend an action to end the spell early to use one of two effects: Break Enchantment (touch a creature within reach to instantly end any charm, frighten, or possession caused by these creature types) or Dismissal (land a melee spell attack on one of these creatures to force a Charisma saving throw, banishing it to its home plane on a failure, or sending fey to the Feywild and undead to the Shadowfell if already on their home plane).

name: Dispel Magic
desc: You choose a creature, object, or magical effect within range, automatically ending any active spell of 3rd level or lower affecting it; for each active spell of 4th level or higher, you must succeed on an ability check using your spellcasting ability (DC = 10 + spell's level) to end it. Upcasting using a 4th-level slot or higher automatically ends any spell on the target with a level equal to or less than the slot used.
damage: Auto < lvl 3, > 3 = spellcasting ability (DC 10 + spell lvl)

name: Divination
desc: You ask a god or their proxy a single question regarding a goal, event, or activity occurring within 7 days, receiving a truthful response (phrase, cryptic rhyme, or omen) that assumes current circumstances remain unchanged without accounting for future variables. Casting this spell additional times before finishing a long rest incurs a cumulative 25% chance per subsequent casting of receiving a secret random reading from the DM.

name: Divine Favor
desc: Your prayer empowers you with divine radiance. Until the spell ends, your weapon attacks deal an extra 1d4 radiant damage on a hit.

name: Divine Word
desc: You utter a divine word, forcing any chosen visible creatures within range that can hear you to make a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, a target suffers an effect based on its current hit points: 50 HP or fewer (deafened for 1 minute), 40 HP or fewer (deafened and blinded for 10 minutes), 30 HP or fewer (blinded, deafened, and stunned for 1 hour), or 20 HP or fewer (killed instantly). Additionally, any celestial, elemental, fey, or fiend that fails the save is instantly banished to its plane of origin (if not already there) and barred from returning for 24 hours by any means short of a wish spell.

name: Dominate Beast
desc: You target a visible beast within range, forcing it to make a Wisdom save (with advantage if you or your allies are fighting it) or be charmed for the duration. While charmed, you maintain a telepathic link across the same plane to issue free-action mental commands it obeys (defaulting to self-defense if idle), take precise action-by-action control using your action (and spending your reaction to make it use its reaction), and the target repeats the Wisdom save to end the spell whenever it takes damage; upcasting using a 5th-, 6th-, or 7th+-level slot extends the maximum concentration duration to 10 minutes, 1 hour, or 8 hours, respectively

name: Dominate Monster
desc: You attempt to beguile a creature that you can see within range. It must succeed on a wisdom saving throw or be charmed by you for the duration. If you or creatures that are friendly to you are fighting it, it has advantage on the saving throw.

name: Dominate Person
desc: You attempt to beguile a humanoid that you can see within range. It must succeed on a wisdom saving throw or be charmed by you for the duration. If you or creatures that are friendly to you are fighting it, it has advantage on the saving throw.

name: Dream
desc: You or a willing creature enter a trance to act as a messenger in the dream of a known sleeping creature on the same plane. You can shape the dream environment for open conversation, or deliver a terrifying 10-word message forcing a Wisdom save; on a failure, the target takes 3d6 psychic damage upon waking and gains no benefit from its rest. Having a physical body part of the target imposes disadvantage on its save.

name: Druidcraft
desc: You whisper to nature spirits to create a harmless effect within range, such as predicting the next 24 hours of local weather, instantly blooming a plant or opening a seed pod, generating a minor sensory effect (like wind or falling leaves) in a 5-foot cube, or lighting or snuffing a small flame.

name: Earthquake
desc: An intense tremor turns a 100-foot-radius area into difficult terrain, forces concentration checks, and requires a Dexterity save each turn or creatures are knocked prone. Fissures open across the area that can swallow creatures, while structures take 50 bludgeoning damage each turn; collapsing structures deal 5d6 bludgeoning damage and bury nearby targets on a failed Dexterity save.

name: Eldritch Blast
desc: You unleash a beam of crackling energy toward a target within range, dealing 1d10 force damage on a successful ranged spell attack. The spell creates additional beams at higher character levels (two at 5th, three at 11th, four at 17th), which can be targeted together or at different creatures with separate attack rolls.

name: Enhance Ability
desc: You bestow a magical enhancement on a touched creature, granting advantage on checks for one chosen ability score: Bear's Endurance (+2d6 temp HP), Bull's Strength (doubled carry capacity), Cat's Grace (no fall damage from ≤20ft), Eagle's Splendor (Charisma), Fox's Cunning (Intelligence), or Owl's Wisdom (Wisdom). You can target one additional creature for each slot level above 2nd.

name: Enlarge/Reduce
desc: You alter the size of a creature or uncarried object within range (unwilling targets make a Constitution save to resist). Enlarge doubles the target's size, octuples its weight, increases its size category by one, grants advantage on Strength checks/saves, and adds +1d4 damage to weapon attacks. Reduce halves its size, reduces weight to one-eighth, decreases size category by one, imposes disadvantage on Strength checks/saves, and subtracts 1d4 damage from weapon attacks (minimum 1).

name: Entangle
desc: Grasping weeds and vines turn a 20-foot square into difficult terrain for the duration. Creatures in the area when cast must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be restrained until the spell ends. A restrained creature can use its action to make a Strength check against your spell save DC to free itself

name: Enthrall
desc: You weave distracting words causing chosen creatures within range that can hear you to make a Wisdom saving throw (targets immune to charm succeed automatically, and targets in combat have advantage). On a failed save, a target has disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks to perceive any creature other than you until the spell ends or it can no longer hear you. The spell ends early if you are incapacitated or cannot speak.

name: Etherealness
desc: You step into the Border Ethereal for the duration or until dismissed, allowing you to move through solid objects from your origin plane. You can see and hear your origin plane in gray up to 60 feet, but can only interact with creatures on the Ethereal Plane. When the spell ends, you return to your origin plane, taking 2 force damage per foot shunted if you materialize inside a solid object or creature.

name: Expeditious Retreat
desc: You can immediately take the Dash action when casting this spell, and continue to take the Dash action as a bonus action on each of your turns for the duration.

name: Eyebite
desc: For the duration, you can use your action each turn to force a visible creature within 60 feet to make a Wisdom saving throw (targets that succeed are immune to this casting). On a failure, you choose one effect: Asleep (unconscious until damaged or shaken awake), Panicked (frightened and must Dash away until >60ft away and out of line of sight), or Sickened (disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks until succeeding on a end-of-turn Wis save).

name: Fabricate
desc: You transform raw materials within range into a finished non-magical product of the same material (up to Large for wood/hemp/cloth, or Medium for metal/stone). You cannot create creatures or magic items, and crafting objects that require high skill (such as weapons, armor, or jewelry) requires proficiency with the corresponding artisan's tools.

name: Faerie Fire
desc: Outlines all objects and creatures failing a Dexterity save within a 20-foot cube in glowing light for the duration. Affected targets shed dim light in a 10-foot radius, cannot benefit from being invisible, and attack rolls against them have advantage if the attacker can see them.

name: Faithful Hound
desc: You conjure an invisible, indestructible watchdog that barks loudly whenever an unauthorized small or larger creature approaches within 30 feet, detecting invisible targets, illusions, and ethereal creatures. At the start of each of your turns, it attacks one hostile creature within 5 feet, dealing 4d8 piercing damage on a hit.

name: False Life
desc: Bolstering yourself with necromantic energy, you gain 1d4 + 4 temporary hit points for the duration. When cast using a 2nd-level spell slot or higher, you gain an additional 5 temporary hit points for each slot level above 1st.

name: Fear
desc: You project a phantasmal image forcing each creature in a 30-foot cone to make a Wisdom saving throw or drop whatever it is holding and become frightened for the duration. A frightened target must take the Dash action and move away from you by the safest available route on each of its turns, but can repeat the Wisdom save to end the spell at the end of its turn if it lacks line of sight to you.

name: Feather Fall
desc: You slow the descent of up to five falling creatures within range to 60 feet per round for the duration. If an affected creature lands before the spell ends, it takes no falling damage, lands safely on its feet, and the spell ends for that creature.

name: Feeblemind
desc: You deal 4d6 psychic damage to a creature within range and force an Intelligence saving throw. On a failure, the target's Intelligence and Charisma scores drop to 1, leaving it unable to cast spells, activate magic items, or communicate, though it can still identify and protect friends. The creature can repeat the save every 30 days to end the effect, or end it via Greater Restoration, Heal, or Wish.

name: Find Familiar
desc: You gain the service of a familiar, a spirit that takes an animal form you choose: bat, cat, crab, frog (toad), hawk, lizard, octopus, owl, poisonous snake, fish (quipper), rat, raven, sea horse, spider, or weasel. Appearing in an unoccupied space within range, the familiar has the statistics of the chosen form, though it is a celestial, fey, or fiend (your choice) instead of a beast.

name: Find Steed
desc: You summon a celestial, fey, or fiend spirit that takes the form of a loyal steed (warhorse, pony, camel, elk, or mastiff) with an Intelligence of at least 6 that understands one language you speak. While mounted, any spell you cast targeting only yourself also targets your steed, and you can communicate telepathically with it while within 1 mile. If dismissed or reduced to 0 hit points, recasting the spell restores and summons the same steed at full health.

name: Find the Path
desc: You determine the shortest, most direct physical route to a specific, familiar fixed location on your current plane of existence. For the duration, you know the exact distance and direction to the destination, and automatically discern the shortest path whenever presented with a choice of routes (though it may not be the safest).

name: Find Traps
desc: You sense the presence of any intentional trap within range and line of sight, including magical alarms, glyphs, and mechanical hazards, though natural hazards like unstable floors are not detected. The spell reveals that a trap is present and indicates the general nature of its danger, but does not reveal its exact location.

name: Finger of Death
desc: You channel negative energy into a visible target within range, forcing a Constitution saving throw for 7d8 + 30 necrotic damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. If a humanoid is killed by this damage, it rises at the start of your next turn as a zombie permanently under your command, executing your verbal orders to the best of its ability.

name: Fire Bolt
desc: You hurl a mote of fire at a target within range, making a ranged spell attack that deals 1d10 fire damage on a hit and ignites flammable uncarried objects. The damage scales to 2d10 at 5th level, 3d10 at 11th level, and 4d10 at 17th level.

name: Fire Shield
desc: Wispy flames wreathe your body, shedding 10 feet of bright light (and 10 feet of dim light) and granting you a choice of a warm shield (cold resistance; retaliates with 2d8 fire damage) or a chill shield (fire resistance; retaliates with 2d8 cold damage). Whenever a creature within 5 feet hits you with a melee attack, the shield erupts to deal its respective damage to the attacker.

name: Fire Storm
desc: You conjure a roaring firestorm made up of up to ten adjacent 10-foot cubes in any layout you choose within range. Creatures in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 7d10 fire damage on a failure or half as much on a success. The spell damages objects, ignites flammable uncarried items, and can optionally leave plant life completely unharmed.

name: Fireball
desc: You launch a streak of flame to a point within range, exploding in a 20-foot radius. Each creature in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 8d6 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The fire spreads around corners and ignites uncarried flammable objects. When cast using a 4th-level spell slot or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 3rd.

name: Flame Blade
desc: You evoke a fiery blade resembling a scimitar in your free hand for the duration, shedding bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet. You can use your action to make a melee spell attack dealing 3d6 fire damage on a hit. If dropped, the blade disappears, but you can re-evoke it as a bonus action. When cast using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for every two slot levels above 2nd.

name: Flame Strike
desc: You call down a vertical column of divine fire in a 10-foot radius, 40-foot-high cylinder centered on a point within range. Each creature in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 4d6 fire damage and 4d6 radiant damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. When cast using a spell slot of 6th level or higher, either the fire damage or the radiant damage (your choice) increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 5th.

name: Flaming Sphere
desc: A 5-foot sphere of fire appears in an unoccupied space within range, shedding bright light in a 20-foot radius (and dim light for 20 more feet) and igniting uncarried flammable objects. Creatures ending their turn within 5 feet must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 2d6 fire damage on a failure or half as much on a success. As a bonus action, you can move the sphere up to 30 feet (hopping 5-foot barriers or 10-foot gaps); ramming a creature forces the save immediately and stops the sphere's movement. When cast using a slot of 3rd level or higher, damage increases by 1d6 per slot level above 2nd.

name: Flesh to Stone
desc: You attempt to turn a visible creature of flesh within range into stone, forcing a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the target is restrained as its body hardens, and it must repeat the save at the end of each of its turns until it accumulates either three successes (ending the spell) or three failures (becoming petrified). If you maintain concentration for the full duration, the petrification becomes permanent until cured; any physical damage sustained while petrified carries over if reverted.
damage: Con save / progressive petrification (3 fails = petrified)

name: Floating Disk
desc: You conjure a 3-foot-diameter, floating plane of force 3 feet off the ground that can carry up to 500 pounds (ending if overloaded). The disk remains immobile while you are within 20 feet of it, but automatically follows to stay within 20 feet if you move farther away, navigating stairs and slopes but unable to cross elevation changes of 10 feet or more. If you move more than 100 feet away from the disk, the spell ends.

name: Fly
desc: You touch a willing creature, granting it a flying speed of 60 feet for the duration. When the spell ends, the target falls if it is still airborne unless it has a way to prevent the fall. When cast using a 4th-level spell slot or higher, you can target one additional willing creature for each slot level above 3rd.

name: Fog Cloud
desc: You conjure a 20-foot-radius sphere of fog centered on a point within range that spreads around corners and heavily obscures the area. The fog lasts for the duration or until dispersed by a wind of at least 10 miles per hour. When cast using a spell slot of 2nd level or higher, the radius increases by 20 feet for each slot level above 1st.

name: Forbiddance
desc: You ward up to 40,000 square feet (30 feet high) against all teleportation, portals, and extraplanar entry (Astral, Ethereal, Feywild, Shadowfell, Plane Shift). You also designate creature types (celestials, elementals, fey, fiends, undead) that take 5d10 radiant or necrotic damage (your choice) upon entering or starting their turn in the area, unless they speak a designated password upon entry. Casting this daily in the same spot for 30 days makes the effect permanent until dispelled.

name: Forcecage
desc: You conjure an immobile, invisible cube of magical force—either a 20-foot bar cage or a solid 10-foot box—trapping any creature completely inside and pushing others outward. The solid box blocks all matter and spells, while both forms extend into the Ethereal Plane, prevent nonmagical escape, and require a successful Charisma saving throw to leave via teleportation or planar travel. This spell cannot be dispelled by Dispel Magic.

name: Foresight
desc: You grant a willing creature the ability to see into the immediate future for the duration. The target cannot be surprised, gains advantage on all attack rolls, ability checks, and saving throws, and imposes disadvantage on attack rolls made against it by other creatures. The spell ends immediately if you cast it again before the duration expires.
damage: Advantage on rolls & disadvantage to be hit

name: Freedom of Movement
desc: You touch a willing creature, making its movement unaffected by difficult terrain and rendering it immune to magical speed reductions, paralysis, and the restrained condition for the duration. The target can spend 5 feet of movement to automatically escape nonmagical restraints or grapples, and suffers no movement or attack penalties while underwater.

name: Freezing Sphere
desc: You launch a frigid globe to a point within range that explodes in a 60-foot-radius sphere, forcing a Constitution saving throw for 10d6 cold damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. It freezes bodies of water to a depth of 6 inches over a 30-foot square area for 1 minute, restraining swimming surface creatures who must use an action to pass a Strength (Athletics) check to break free. Alternatively, you can hold the globe in hand (or pass/throw/sling it) to detonate on impact or automatically explode after 1 minute. When cast using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, the damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 6th.

name: Gaseous Form
desc: You transform a willing creature and its equipment into a misty cloud with a 10-foot flying speed that can hover, occupy other creatures' spaces, and pass through tiny cracks (while treating liquids as solid). The target gains resistance to nonmagical damage and advantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saving throws, but cannot talk, attack, cast spells, drop, or interact with objects.

name: Gate
desc: You conjure a circular portal (5 to 20 feet in diameter) linking an unoccupied space within range to a precise location on another plane for the duration. Travel occurs instantly by entering the portal's front face, though planar rulers can block portals from opening in their presence or domains. If you speak the exact name of a specific creature on another plane during casting, the portal opens near them and pulls them through to your side; the target is entirely free to act as it wishes.

name: Geas
desc: You issue a directive or prohibition to a creature within range that can understand you, forcing a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, the target is charmed for the duration and takes 5d10 psychic damage once per day whenever it acts directly counter to your instructions. Suicidal commands immediately end the spell, and it can be cured via Remove Curse, Greater Restoration, or Wish. When cast using a 7th–8th level slot, the duration increases to 1 year; at 9th level, it lasts until dispelled or cured.
damage: Wis save / quest command (5d10 psychic damage 1/day on violation)

name: Gentle Repose
desc: You touch a corpse or remains, protecting the target from natural decay and preventing it from being turned into an undead creature for the duration. Additionally, any days spent under the effect of this spell do not count against the operational time limit of resurrecting spells like Raise Dead.

name: Giant Insect
desc: You transform small vermin within range—up to 10 centipedes, 3 spiders, 5 wasps, or 1 scorpion—into their giant beast equivalents for the duration. The enlarged creatures obey your verbal commands, take their actions on your turn in combat, and revert to normal if reduced to 0 hit points or dismissed as an action. The DM may permit other similar bugs using equivalent giant stat blocks (e.g., using giant wasp stats for a giant bee).
damage: Vermin transformation / up to 10 giant beasts

name: Glibness
desc: For the duration, whenever you make a Charisma check, you can treat a roll lower than 15 as a 15. Additionally, any magic used to determine whether you are telling the truth always indicates that you are being truthful, regardless of what you actually say.
damage: Min 15 Charisma & immunity to magical truth-detection

name: Globe of Invulnerability
desc: You conjure an immobile, 10-foot-radius shimmering barrier centered on you for the duration. Any spell of 5th level or lower cast from outside the barrier cannot affect creatures or objects inside, nor can its area of effect penetrate the barrier, even if upcast. Higher-level spells function normally. When cast using a spell slot of 7th level or higher, the maximum spell level blocked increases by 1 for each slot level above 6th.
damage: 10ft anti-magic barrier / immunity to ≤5th-level spells (+1 spell level blocked per slot level)

name: Glyph of Warding
desc: When you cast this spell, you inscribe a glyph that harms other creatures, either upon a surface (such as a table or a section of floor or wall) or within an object that can be closed (such as a book, a scroll, or a treasure chest) to conceal the glyph. If you choose a surface, the glyph can cover an area of the surface no larger than 10 feet in diameter. If you choose an object, that object must remain in its place; if the object is moved more than 10 feet from where you cast this spell, the glyph is broken, and the spell ends without being triggered.

name: Goodberry
desc: Up to ten berries appear in your hand and are infused with magic for the duration. A creature can use its action to eat one berry. Eating a berry restores 1 hit point, and the berry provides enough nourishment to sustain a creature for a day.

name: Grease
desc: Slick grease covers the ground in a 10-foot square centered on a point within range and turns it into difficult terrain for the duration.

name: Greater Invisibility
desc: You or a creature you touch becomes invisible until the spell ends. Anything the target is wearing or carrying is invisible as long as it is on the target's person.

name: Greater Restoration
desc: You imbue a creature you touch with positive energy to undo a debilitating effect. You can reduce the target's exhaustion level by one, or end one of the following effects on the target:

name: Guardian of Faith
desc: A Large spectral guardian appears and hovers for the duration in an unoccupied space of your choice that you can see within range. The guardian occupies that space and is indistinct except for a gleaming sword and shield emblazoned with the symbol of your deity.

name: Guards and Wards
desc: You create a ward that protects up to 2,500 square feet of floor space (an area 50 feet square, or one hundred 5-foot squares or twenty-five 10-foot squares). The warded area can be up to 20 feet tall, and shaped as you desire. You can ward several stories of a stronghold by dividing the area among them, as long as you can walk into each contiguous area while you are casting the spell.

name: Guidance
desc: You touch one willing creature. Once before the spell ends, the target can roll a d4 and add the number rolled to one ability check of its choice. It can roll the die before or after making the ability check. The spell then ends.

name: Guiding Bolt
desc: A flash of light streaks toward a creature of your choice within range. Make a ranged spell attack against the target. On a hit, the target takes 4d6 radiant damage, and the next attack roll made against this target before the end of your next turn has advantage, thanks to the mystical dim light glittering on the target until then.

name: Gust of Wind
desc: A line of strong wind 60 feet long and 10 feet wide blasts from you in a direction you choose for the spell's duration. Each creature that starts its turn in the line must succeed on a strength saving throw or be pushed 15 feet away from you in a direction following the line.

name: Hallow
desc: You touch a point and infuse an area around it with holy (or unholy) power. The area can have a radius up to 60 feet, and the spell fails if the radius includes an area already under the effect a hallow spell. The affected area is subject to the following effects.

name: Hallucinatory Terrain
desc: You make natural terrain in a 150-foot cube in range look, sound, and smell like some other sort of natural terrain. Thus, open fields or a road can be made to resemble a swamp, hill, crevasse, or some other difficult or impassable terrain. A pond can be made to seem like a grassy meadow, a precipice like a gentle slope, or a rock-strewn gully like a wide and smooth road. Manufactured structures, equipment, and creatures within the area aren't changed in appearance.

name: Harm
desc: You unleash a virulent disease on a creature that you can see within range. The target must make a constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes 14d6 necrotic damage, or half as much damage on a successful save. The damage can't reduce the target's hit points below 1. If the target fails the saving throw, its hit point maximum is reduced for 1 hour by an amount equal to the necrotic damage it took. Any effect that removes a disease allows a creature's hit point maximum to return to normal before that time passes.

name: Haste
desc: Choose a willing creature that you can see within range. Until the spell ends, the target's speed is doubled, it gains a +2 bonus to AC, it has advantage on dexterity saving throws, and it gains an additional action on each of its turns. That action can be used only to take the Attack (one weapon attack only), Dash, Disengage, Hide, or Use an Object action.

name: Heal
desc: Choose a creature that you can see within range. A surge of positive energy washes through the creature, causing it to regain 70 hit points. This spell also ends blindness, deafness, and any diseases affecting the target. This spell has no effect on constructs or undead.

name: Healing Word
desc: A creature of your choice that you can see within range regains hit points equal to 1d4 + your spellcasting ability modifier. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs.

name: Heat Metal
desc: Choose a manufactured metal object, such as a metal weapon or a suit of heavy or medium metal armor, that you can see within range. You cause the object to glow red-hot. Any creature in physical contact with the object takes 2d8 fire damage when you cast the spell. Until the spell ends, you can use a bonus action on each of your subsequent turns to cause this damage again.

name: Hellish Rebuke
desc: You point your finger, and the creature that damaged you is momentarily surrounded by hellish flames. The creature must make a dexterity saving throw. It takes 2d10 fire damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

name: Heroes' Feast
desc: You bring forth a great feast, including magnificent food and drink. The feast takes 1 hour to consume and disappears at the end of that time, and the beneficial effects don't set in until this hour is over. Up to twelve other creatures can partake of the feast.

name: Heroism
desc: A willing creature you touch is imbued with bravery. Until the spell ends, the creature is immune to being frightened and gains temporary hit points equal to your spellcasting ability modifier at the start of each of its turns. When the spell ends, the target loses any remaining temporary hit points from this spell.

name: Hideous Laughter
desc: A creature of your choice that you can see within range perceives everything as hilariously funny and falls into fits of laughter if this spell affects it. The target must succeed on a wisdom saving throw or fall prone, becoming incapacitated and unable to stand up for the duration. A creature with an Intelligence score of 4 or less isn't affected.

name: Hold Monster
desc: Choose a creature you can see and reach. The target must make a saving throw of Wisdom or be paralyzed for the duration of the spell. This spell has no effect against the undead. At the end of each round, the target can make a new saving throw of Wisdom. If successful, the spell ends for the creature.

name: Hold Person
desc: Choose a humanoid that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a wisdom saving throw or be paralyzed for the duration. At the end of each of its turns, the target can make another wisdom saving throw. On a success, the spell ends on the target.

name: Holy Aura
desc: Divine light washes out from you and coalesces in a soft radiance in a 30-foot radius around you. Creatures of your choice in that radius when you cast this spell shed dim light in a 5-foot radius and have advantage on all saving throws, and other creatures have disadvantage on attack rolls against them until the spell ends. In addition, when a fiend or an undead hits an affected creature with a melee attack, the aura flashes with brilliant light. The attacker must succeed on a constitution saving throw or be blinded until the spell ends.

name: Hunter's Mark
desc: You choose a creature you can see within range and mystically mark it as your quarry. Until the spell ends, you deal an extra 1d6 damage to the target whenever you hit it with a weapon attack, and you have advantage on any Wisdom (Perception) or Wisdom (Survival) check you make to find it. If the target drops to 0 hit points before this spell ends, you can use a bonus action on a subsequent turn of yours to mark a new creature.

name: Hypnotic Pattern
desc: You create a twisting pattern of colors that weaves through the air inside a 30-foot cube within range. The pattern appears for a moment and vanishes. Each creature in the area who sees the pattern must make a wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the creature becomes charmed for the duration. While charmed by this spell, the creature is incapacitated and has a speed of 0.

name: Ice Storm
desc: A hail of rock-hard ice pounds to the ground in a 20-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder centered on a point within range. Each creature in the cylinder must make a dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 2d8 bludgeoning damage and 4d6 cold damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

name: Identify
desc: You choose one object that you must touch throughout the casting of the spell. If it is a magic item or some other magic-imbued object, you learn its properties and how to use them, whether it requires attunement to use, and how many charges it has, if any. You learn whether any spells are affecting the item and what they are. If the item was created by a spell, you learn which spell created it.

name: Illusory Script
desc: You write on parchment, paper, or some other suitable writing material and imbue it with a potent illusion that lasts for the duration.

name: Imprisonment
desc: You create a magical restraint to hold a creature that you can see within range. The target must succeed on a wisdom saving throw or be bound by the spell; if it succeeds, it is immune to this spell if you cast it again. While affected by this spell, the creature doesn't need to breathe, eat, or drink, and it doesn't age. Divination spells can't locate or perceive the target.

name: Incendiary Cloud
desc: A swirling cloud of smoke shot through with white-hot embers appears in a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point within range. The cloud spreads around corners and is heavily obscured. It lasts for the duration or until a wind of moderate or greater speed (at least 10 miles per hour) disperses it.

name: Inflict Wounds
desc: Make a melee spell attack against a creature you can reach. On a hit, the target takes 3d10 necrotic damage.

name: Insect Plague
desc: Swarming, biting locusts fill a 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you choose within range. The sphere spreads around corners. The sphere remains for the duration, and its area is lightly obscured. The sphere's area is difficult terrain.

name: Instant Summons
desc: You touch an object weighing 10 pounds or less whose longest dimension is 6 feet or less. The spell leaves an invisible mark on its surface and invisibly inscribes the name of the item on the sapphire you use as the material component. Each time you cast this spell, you must use a different sapphire.

name: Invisibility
desc: A creature you touch becomes invisible until the spell ends. Anything the target is wearing or carrying is invisible as long as it is on the target's person. The spell ends for a target that attacks or casts a spell.

name: Irresistible Dance
desc: Choose one creature that you can see within range. The target begins a comic dance in place: shuffling, tapping its feet, and capering for the duration. Creatures that can't be charmed are immune to this spell.

name: Jump
desc: You touch a creature. The creature's jump distance is tripled until the spell ends.

name: Knock
desc: Choose an object that you can see within range. The object can be a door, a box, a chest, a set of manacles, a padlock, or another object that contains a mundane or magical means that prevents access.

name: Legend Lore
desc: Name or describe a person, place, or object. The spell brings to your mind a brief summary of the significant lore about the thing you named. The lore might consist of current tales, forgotten stories, or even secret lore that has never been widely known. If the thing you named isn't of legendary importance, you gain no information. The more information you already have about the thing, the more precise and detailed the information you receive is.

name: Lesser Restoration
desc: You touch a creature and can end either one disease or one condition afflicting it. The condition can be blinded, deafened, paralyzed, or poisoned.

name: Levitate
desc: One creature or object of your choice that you can see within range rises vertically, up to 20 feet, and remains suspended there for the duration. The spell can levitate a target that weighs up to 500 pounds. An unwilling creature that succeeds on a constitution saving throw is unaffected.

name: Light
desc: You touch one object that is no larger than 10 feet in any dimension. Until the spell ends, the object sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet. The light can be colored as you like. Completely covering the object with something opaque blocks the light. The spell ends if you cast it again or dismiss it as an action.

name: Lightning Bolt
desc: A stroke of lightning forming a line 100 feet long and 5 feet wide blasts out from you in a direction you choose. Each creature in the line must make a dexterity saving throw. A creature takes 8d6 lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

name: Locate Animals or Plants
desc: Describe or name a specific kind of beast or plant. Concentrating on the voice of nature in your surroundings, you learn the direction and distance to the closest creature or plant of that kind within 5 miles, if any are present.

name: Locate Creature
desc: Describe or name a creature that is familiar to you. You sense the direction to the creature's location, as long as that creature is within 1,000 feet of you. If the creature is moving, you know the direction of its movement.

name: Locate Object
desc: Describe or name an object that is familiar to you. You sense the direction to the object's location, as long as that object is within 1,000 feet of you. If the object is in motion, you know the direction of its movement.

name: Longstrider
desc: You touch a creature. The target's speed increases by 10 feet until the spell ends.

name: Mage Armor
desc: You touch a willing creature who isn't wearing armor, and a protective magical force surrounds it until the spell ends. The target's base AC becomes 13 + its Dexterity modifier. The spell ends if the target dons armor or if you dismiss the spell as an action.

name: Mage Hand
desc: A spectral, floating hand appears at a point you choose within range. The hand lasts for the duration or until you dismiss it as an action. The hand vanishes if it is ever more than 30 feet away from you or if you cast this spell again.

name: Magic Circle
desc: You create a 10-foot radius, 20-foot-tall cylinder of magical energy centered on a point on the ground that you can see within range. Glowing runes appear whenever the cylinder intersects with the floor or other surface.

name: Magic Jar
desc: Your body falls into a catatonic state as your soul leaves it and enters the container you used for the spell's material component. While your soul inhabits the container, you are aware of your surroundings as if you were in the container's space. You can't move or use reactions. The only action you can take is to project your soul up to 100 feet out of the container, either returning to your living body (and ending the spell) or attempting to possess a humanoids body.

name: Magic Missile
desc: You create three glowing darts of magical force. Each dart hits a creature of your choice that you can see within range. A dart deals 1d4 + 1 force damage to its target. The darts all strike simultaneously, and you can direct them to hit one creature or several.

name: Magic Mouth
desc: You plant a message to an object in the range of the spell. The message is verbalized when the trigger conditions are met. Choose an object that you see, and that is not worn or carried by another creature. Then say the message, which should not exceed 25 words but listening can take up to 10 minutes. Finally, establish the circumstances that trigger the spell to deliver your message.

name: Magic Weapon
desc: You touch a nonmagical weapon. Until the spell ends, that weapon becomes a magic weapon with a +1 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls.

name: Magnificent Mansion
desc: You conjure an extradimensional dwelling in range that lasts for the duration. You choose where its one entrance is located. The entrance shimmers faintly and is 5 feet wide and 10 feet tall. You and any creature you designate when you cast the spell can enter the extradimensional dwelling as long as the portal remains open. You can open or close the portal if you are within 30 feet of it. While closed, the portal is invisible.

name: Major Image
desc: You create the image of an object, a creature, or some other visible phenomenon that is no larger than a 20-foot cube. The image appears at a spot that you can see within range and lasts for the duration. It seems completely real, including sounds, smells, and temperature appropriate to the thing depicted. You can't create sufficient heat or cold to cause damage, a sound loud enough to deal thunder damage or deafen a creature, or a smell that might sicken a creature (like a troglodyte's stench).

name: Mass Cure Wounds
desc: A wave of healing energy washes out from a point of your choice within range. Choose up to six creatures in a 30-foot-radius sphere centered on that point. Each target regains hit points equal to 3d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs.

name: Mass Heal
desc: A flood of healing energy flows from you into injured creatures around you. You restore up to 700 hit points, divided as you choose among any number of creatures that you can see within range. Creatures healed by this spell are also cured of all diseases and any effect making them blinded or deafened. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs.

name: Mass Healing Word
desc: As you call out words of restoration, up to six creatures of your choice that you can see within range regain hit points equal to 1d4 + your spellcasting ability modifier. This spell has no effect on undead or constructs.

name: Mass Suggestion
desc: You suggest a course of activity (limited to a sentence or two) and magically influence up to twelve creatures of your choice that you can see within range and that can hear and understand you. Creatures that can't be charmed are immune to this effect. The suggestion must be worded in such a manner as to make the course of action sound reasonable. Asking the creature to stab itself, throw itself onto a spear, immolate itself, or do some other obviously harmful act automatically negates the effect of the spell.

name: Maze
desc: You banish a creature that you can see within range into a labyrinthine demiplane. The target remains there for the duration or until it escapes the maze.

name: Meld Into Stone
desc: You step into a stone object or surface large enough to fully contain your body, melding yourself and all the equipment you carry with the stone for the duration. Using your movement, you step into the stone at a point you can touch. Nothing of your presence remains visible or otherwise detectable by nonmagical senses.

name: Mending
desc: This spell repairs a single break or tear in an object you touch, such as a broken key, a torn cloak, or a leaking wineskin. As long as the break or tear is no longer than 1 foot in any dimension, you mend it, leaving no trace of the former damage.

name: Message
desc: You point your finger toward a creature within range and whisper a message. The target (and only the target) hears the message and can reply in a whisper that only you can hear.

name: Meteor Swarm
desc: Blazing orbs of fire plummet to the ground at four different points you can see within range. Each creature in a 40-foot-radius sphere centered on each point you choose must make a dexterity saving throw. The sphere spreads around corners. A creature takes 20d6 fire damage and 20d6 bludgeoning damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. A creature in the area of more than one fiery burst is affected only once.

name: Mind Blank
desc: Until the spell ends, one willing creature you touch is immune to psychic damage, any effect that would sense its emotions or read its thoughts, divination spells, and the charmed condition. The spell even foils wish spells and spells or effects of similar power used to affect the target's mind or to gain information about the target.

name: Minor Illusion
desc: You create a sound or an image of an object within range that lasts for the duration. The illusion also ends if you dismiss it as an action or cast this spell again.

name: Mirage Arcane
desc: You make terrain in an area up to 1 mile square look, sound, smell, and even feel like some other sort of terrain. The terrain's general shape remains the same, however. Open fields or a road could be made to resemble a swamp, hill, crevasse, or some other difficult or impassable terrain. A pond can be made to seem like a grassy meadow, a precipice like a gentle slope, or a rock-strewn gully like a wide and smooth road.

name: Mirror Image
desc: Three illusory duplicates of yourself appear in your space. Until the spell ends, the duplicates move with you and mimic your actions, shifting position so it's impossible to track which image is real. You can use your action to dismiss the illusory duplicates.

name: Mislead
desc: You become invisible at the same time that an illusory double of you appears where you are standing. The double lasts for the duration, but the invisibility ends if you attack or cast a spell.

name: Misty Step
desc: Briefly surrounded by silvery mist, you teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space that you can see.

name: Modify Memory
desc: You attempt to reshape another creature's memories. One creature that you can see must make a wisdom saving throw. If you are fighting the creature, it has advantage on the saving throw. On a failed save, the target becomes charmed by you for the duration. The charmed target is incapacitated and unaware of its surroundings, though it can still hear you. If it takes any damage or is targeted by another spell, this spell ends, and none of the target's memories are modified.

name: Moonbeam
desc: A silvery beam of pale light shines down in a 5-foot radius, 40-foot-high cylinder centered on a point within range. Until the spell ends, dim light fills the cylinder.

name: Move Earth
